rows.why: Both verbatim clauses (reasonable charges not to exceed actual cost incurred in accessing/duplicating/supplying/searching + lowest-possible-cost duty; duplicating fee shall not exceed actual cost of duplication) string-match § 2.2-3704(F) in the owner-supplied official text (source_docs/VA_2.2-3704_2026-08-20.txt). actual_cost_standard with ceiling basis under a Permission is the right resolution (no number stated); applies_to all_public_bodies correct — 'a public body' with no agency/local split; history line ends 2023 c. 534, no 2024-2026 amendment.

Verbatim 'Any duplicating fee charged by a public body shall not exceed the actual cost of duplication.' present in § 2.2-3704(F); no color-specific rate anywhere in the section; actual_cost_standard/ceiling correct; current through 2023 c. 534.
Same verbatim duplication-ceiling clause present; no oversized/nonstandard rate in the section; actual_cost_standard/ceiling correct.

Verbatim GIS/topographical-map clause ('such charges shall not exceed the actual cost ... except that the public body may charge, on a pro rata per acre basis, for the cost of creating topographical maps ... contiguous area greater than 50 acres') string-matches § 2.2-3704(F). actual_cost_standard with the >50-acre carve-out noted, not converted to a value — correct.

Verbatim (F) clause present ('searching for' expressly chargeable up to actual cost incurred); no hourly figure exists — actual_cost_standard/ceiling correct. Secondary authority § 2.2-3704.1 opened on law.lis.virginia.gov: written fee-policy posting clause verbatim as recorded in VA-9007, history ends 2023 c. 599 (no 2024-2026 amendment).

Verbatim (F) clause present. The four enumerated activities (accessing, duplicating, supplying, searching) indeed never name review/redaction; medium confidence + manual_verification flag for FOIA Council opinions is the honest recording. actual_cost_standard correct.

Verbatim § 2.2-3704(G) clause present ('shall be made available to a requester at a reasonable cost, not to exceed the actual cost in accordance with subsection F'). actual_cost_standard/ceiling under a Requirement correct; excision/format-conversion not-new-record clause also verified in (G).

Verbatim (F) clause present. Engine-enum value 'always' is right: no free-hours trigger, page threshold, or paper-only scope anywhere in § 2.2-3704; SB 56 (2026, free labor hours) confirmed NOT in the codified text — history line ends 2023 c. 534.

Verbatim surplus-fee prohibition present in (F) ('No public body shall impose any extraneous, intermediary, or surplus fees or expenses to recoup the general costs...'). not_applicable is correct: an overhead/fringe % surcharge is categorically barred (actual-cost cap + surplus prohibition); the per-employee-fringe nuance is properly a manual_verification note, not a number.

Silent with coverage note. No per-requestor periodic free-time provision in the section.

Verbatim pre-search written-notice + estimate-inquiry clause and 'shall provide the requester with a cost estimate if requested' string-match § 2.2-3704(F). structural is right — a universal notice duty (threshold effectively zero) with estimate-on-request, not a dollar threshold value.
Verbatim 30-day deemed-withdrawal clause present in (F). value=30 days, basis fixed, Deadline — statute-fixed figure, correct resolution word; calendar-vs-business ambiguity honestly noted.

Silent with coverage note. No estimate-validity period; the 30-day window is correctly distinguished as the requester's reply window.

Verbatim § 2.2-3704(H) clause present ('likely to exceed $200 ... may, before continuing to process the request, require the requester to pay a deposit not to exceed the amount of the advance determination'). value=$200 fixed under a Permission is right — the trigger figure is state-fixed even though the deposit itself is permissive.

Verbatim (H) clauses present including mandatory crediting. ceiling is the right word ('not to exceed the amount of the advance determination'); the 100% rendering is an exact arithmetic restatement of that cap, with the unit field explicitly disclosing the statute's own phrasing — not a converted soft standard.

Both verbatim clauses present: (F) 30-day estimate non-response deemed withdrawal and (I) prior-debt gate. structural/Trigger correct; correctly distinguishes estimate non-response from final-bill nonpayment (statute silent on the latter).

Verbatim (H) tolling clause present ('tolled for the amount of time that elapses between notice of the advance determination and the response of the requester'). structural/tolls correct; the response-vs-payment gap is accurately flagged.
